pricing.rule: Each delivered call bills price_usd × 1.15 + $0.005. A pending/async ack or an unverifiable charged call (delivered:false, refundable:false) bills price_usd × 1.15 with no per-call fee; refunded calls, in-batch duplicates and failed runs bill $0. A call runs only when its full delivered amount fits the batch's remaining max_usd, so max_usd must be at least Σ(price_usd × 1.15 + $0.005).

comment.comment:
I'm so bullish on this coin and here's why:

Some of you may be thinking "Oh it hasn't gone up yet" or "It's stuck at the same spot" but you really have to think about the pathway that a good coin has to walk before it reaches it's real potential. Good things are built in quiet, they aren't overly exaggerated, they aren't the #1 hit usually. For example, when somebody decides that they are a millionaire, do they just summon 1 million dollars right in their hand that same very second or do they state what they are and start walking the pathway that gets them there? They walk the pathway to get there otherwise they aren't a millionaire, they walked through the storm they kept their faith regardless of what people had told them, they kept walking despite checking their bank account to see $20 in it. What $NTRNDM has been doing is what this space needs and that doesn't mean that it instantly will shoot up to the sky, I have been here since this coin was at 30k mc and there were days where we went to 100k or even 200k and went straight back down to 60k again, that was the floor at the time. The coin is still in the same repetition, same pattern however there is a new floor each and every single time you can check for yourselves. We are at 521k mc at the second of typing this and when I tell you a 30k mc - 521k mc jump in just 2 weeks HOLDING the floor whilst also creating new floors is more than enough conviction for me. Some coins may get that attention we want, but they die out in 1 hour 2 hours a couple days and then never get seen again, we are actually building here, we are moving forward, and we aren't skipping any steps. If you aren't here to hold that's okay, your money your choice and you can still make the bag you desire because this coin already has reached massive heights, whether its today, tomorrow, right now or in a week we wont be able to decide but we can do the hard part and stay true to ourselves. I'm so happy to see what this dev has been shipping and what this coin has done, this trade is my #1 trade by far after 2 months of failing and losing to my emotions. I could easily sell right now but I'm not here to bring comfort into my life, I'm here to create a new life. It doesn't take time to build, it takes consistency, effort and faith and although that may feel like "time" it is a completely different concept. Look at the all time chart, study the dev, study the launchpad and figure out for yourself if this is a play you want to make but like I said good things are built in quiet behind the scenes, just because it didn't shoot up to 10m rn or 1m right now that doesn't mean there isn't any effort here. Make your decision and let the game play itself because you have no control over what happens, you can only decide how you react when it all plays out. Much love and have a nice night/day depending on where you are in this world all love! 🚀💎💖
